categories.name: Resolve via timely payment
categories.description: Resolution of the fine case through early payment before penalty or further enforcement steps. Advances Maximize timely fine revenue and Minimize administrative & enforcement cost.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative 12, observed in variant V0004 where payment occurs immediately after fine creation.

categories.name: Resolve via delinquent payment
categories.description: Resolution of the fine case through payment after notification and penalty have been applied. Helps Maximize timely fine revenue.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative 13, observed in variant V0003 where payment follows fine notification and penalty addition.

categories.name: Resolve via administrative appeal to the Prefecture
categories.description: Contested appeal resolved through administrative process via the Prefecture. Preserves offender's due-process rights while impacting costs and revenue.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative 14, observed in variant V0006 involving insertion of appeal date, sending appeal, and receiving results.

categories.name: Resolve via judicial appeal to the Judge
categories.description: Contested appeal resolved through the judicial system. Makes a strong positive contribution to preserving offender's due-process rights while hurting administrative costs.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative 19, observed in variant V0005 where the case concludes with an appeal to the judge.

categories.name: Resolve via coercive credit collection
categories.description: Resolution of the fine case through coercive credit collection procedures after notifications and penalties. Helps timely revenue while hurting enforcement costs.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative 20, observed in variant V0002 where the case concludes by sending for credit collection.
